tool.name: LuxAlgo
tool.description: LuxAlgo is a charting workspace with a large indicator library, order-flow tools and a coding assistant called Quant. A free plan is listed. Paid plans add more history, alerts and credits.
features: Charts with a large indicator library
Order-flow tools, including footprints, delta and profiles
Quant credits for the coding and backtesting assistant
Strategy alerts, with webhook automation on higher plans
Live CME futures data on paid plans

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: Includes charts, a short order-flow lookback and a small monthly credit allowance.

plans.name: Essential
plans.detail: Month to month. Annual billing was shown as $17.49/mo for the first year ($209.92), then $299.88 per year.

plans.name: Premium
plans.detail: Month to month. Annual billing was shown as $25.99/mo for the first year ($311.92), then $479.88 per year.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.detail: Renewal annual price. The first year was shown as $395.93. A separate month-to-month price was not clearly labelled.

plans.name: AI Ultra
plans.detail: Renewal annual price. The first year was shown as $575.95. A separate month-to-month price was not clearly labelled.

tool.pricing_note: Prices from the official pricing page on 11 Oct 2026. Introductory annual amounts and later renewal amounts were both on the page. The FAQ says the first payment has a 30-day money-back window.
